metadata.name: Refactoring engine
metadata.capas: frontend, backend, or full-stack. Full-stack order is shared contract, backend, frontend, integrator.

compuerta.requerido: SRS in docs/planning/ or legacy docs/vexarq/current/srs/.
SAD in docs/design/ or legacy docs/vexarq/current/sad/.
Backlog in docs/planning/ or legacy docs/vexarq/current/backlog/.
Test strategy, coverage plan, or test specification in docs/quality/.
compuerta.ausente: Return exactly: BLOCKED — REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION MISSING. Then list each missing document and why it is needed. Do not edit code. Read-only search for the documents is allowed.
compuerta.excepcion: The user may name a substitute source of truth in the conversation. Record the substitution, its limit, and the risk in the assessment. Do not invent the substitution.

fases.fase: Confirm scope, goals, non-goals, and the definition of done.
Run the quality-pipeline baseline. Add characterization tests before changing weakly tested behavior.
Analyze debt, boundaries, and contracts. Call security, complexity, or performance auditors only when the factory routing rule says so.
Plan small behavior-preserving steps. Name the technique and the rollback. Prefer expand, migrate, and contract for data and APIs.
Execute one step at a time. After each code change, rerun the quality pipeline from G-00.
Compare the final behavior with the baseline. A public contract changes only when the SRS allows it.

prohibido.regla: Do not delete or weaken a test to finish a refactor.
If the change would contradict the SAD, stop and propose an ADR.
Do not copy backend or frontend policies into this file. Reference them.
